candidates.statement: Checks news about once every two days, mainly through the news application and Google search recommendations.

evidence_candidates.quote: I look through the headlines, and then I just scroll down through the whole page to look if I if I find any interesting articles that are that are like related to what I'm interested in

evidence_candidates.quote: some of the some of the content that I'm interested is in technology
